page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn9gc-8x.64xlarge is an accelerated compute instance belonging to the Compute Optimized with GPU family. Built on KVM virtualization, it pairs high-density host compute with multi-accelerator processing to target demanding parallel workloads. The configuration is powered by dedicated x86_64 AMD EPYC 9A75 processors operating at a base frequency of 3.3 GHz, delivering 256 virtual CPUs alongside 1536.0 GB of system memory, which yields 6.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is anchored by eight NVIDIA Blackwell architecture GPUs providing an aggregate 576 GB of total VRAM. For network-intensive throughput, the instance provides a 200 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance includes no local storage, requiring persistent data and scratch spaces to be attached via networked cloud storage volumes. It also allocates zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses by default, reflecting its intended deployment within isolated private virtual cloud topologies.

From an efficiency and operational standpoint, the dense co-location of 256 high-clock AMD cores, 1.5 TB of memory, and eight Blackwell accelerators maximizes compute density in a single node. This resource concentration minimizes multi-node clustering overhead for workloads that fit within an eight-accelerator envelope. The architectural tradeoff is the absence of integrated local NVMe storage, meaning storage throughput depends directly on the network fabric and provisioned remote storage solutions. Suitable workloads include large-scale deep learning model training, massive parallel inference pipelines, high-performance computing simulations, and data-intensive distributed analytics.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn9gc-8x.64xlarge is an accelerated compute instance in the Compute Optimized with GPU family, engineered for large-scale parallel processing. The server is powered by dedicated x86_64 AMD EPYC 9A75 processors clocked at 3.3 GHz, delivering 256 vCPUs and 1536.0 GB of system RAM. Hardware acceleration features eight NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs offering a combined 576 GB of VRAM. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 200 Gbps to support high-throughput data exchanges. The instance comes with no integrated local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for operating system and data requirements. With its dense core count, extensive VRAM, and high-speed networking, this instance provides high resource consolidation for multi-GPU training, large language model inference, and distributed scientific simulation tasks without the network overhead of multi-node clustering.
